To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the neurite- stimulating factor released by rat schwannoma cells contains immunoreactivity to laminin and that this immunoreactivity is essential to the neurite-promotion activity of the factor.

the purified schwannomma neurite-promoting factors contains immunoreactive laminin, and that the neurite- promiting activities of the factor and of laminin are both blocked by antibodies raised against the factor.
the neurite-promo ting factor released from rat RN22 schwannomas is immunologically and biochemically similar to laminin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation and characterization of a macromolecular neurite-promoting substance released from cultured rat schwannoma cells.
the purification and characterization of the neurite-promotion factor released by RN22 rat schwannoma cells into the medium in which the cells are grown.
the isolation and characterization of rat RN22 schwann cells and the identification of a neurite-promoting substance released from the cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the neurite-promotion activity released by the rat RN22 schwann cell line is due to laminin and possibly to proteoglyc can(s) as well.
the neurite-promotion activity released by RN22 cells is due to the presence of laminin.
the rat schwannomas release a factor into their culture media which, after purification, is composed of laminin and proteoglycan.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the schwannoma neuritogenic factor contains laminin and possibly other molecules.

the neurite-promotion factor released by RN22 schwannomas contains laminin immunoreactive material and that the neurite promotion activity of the factor is blocked by antibodies raised against laminin.
the neurite-promotion activity of the schwannomas factor is due to laminin.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the rat schwannomas release into their growth media a factor that has the same neurite-promoting properties as laminin, that co- purifies with immunoreactive laminin, and that has a molecular architecture similar to that of laminin.

the neurite-promotion factor isolated from RN22 cells is laminin and, as such, it is the first example of an in vitro preparation of laminin that can be used to stimulate neurite regeneration from axotomal neurons.   1.
